culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Mitsuyuki Arimori. He murdered Chizuru early in the morning, first he knocked her out with a stungun and hid the corpse in the back of his van then he Strangled her with a rope when the group headed to the valley. Later, in the afternoon he used a hang-glider to get back to the hotel before the others and hung her corpse her room.

motive.quote: He reveals that the actress was his brother's lover, she had made him spend large amounts of money repeatedly and although his brother truly loved her she did not.

method.quote: He murdered Chizuru early in the morning, first he knocked her out with a stungun and hid the corpse in the back of his van then he Strangled her with a rope when the group headed to the valley.

evidence.quote: The proof is a special type of pollen unique to a butterfly from the valley that was on Chizuru's clothes that had been unknowingly transferred from Arimori's shoulder when he was carrying the corpse.

motive.zhHans: 他供称，那位女演员是他哥哥的恋人；她屡次让他为她花掉大笔钱财，而他哥哥真心爱她，她却并非如此。
motive.en: He reveals that the actress was his brother's lover, she had made him spend large amounts of money repeatedly and although his brother truly loved her she did not.

method.zhHans: 他在清晨杀害了千鹤：先用麻醉枪将她击倒，把尸体藏在面包车后部；等一行人前往山谷时，再用绳子将她勒死。当天下午，他乘悬挂式滑翔翼抢先回到旅馆，把她的尸体吊在房间里。
method.en: He murdered Chizuru early in the morning, first he knocked her out with a stungun and hid the corpse in the back of his van then he Strangled her with a rope when the group headed to the valley. Later, in the afternoon he used a hang-glider to get back to the hotel before the others and hung her corpse her room.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是千鹤衣服上一种只产于该山谷的蝴蝶的特殊花粉——那是他搬运尸体时，从 Arimori 肩上无意间沾过去的。
evidence.en: The proof is a special type of pollen unique to a butterfly from the valley that was on Chizuru's clothes that had been unknowingly transferred from Arimori's shoulder when he was carrying the corpse.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Mitsuyuki Arimori。他在清晨杀害了千鹤：先用麻醉枪将她击倒，把尸体藏在面包车后部；等一行人前往山谷时，再用绳子将她勒死。当天下午，他乘悬挂式滑翔翼抢先回到旅馆，把她的尸体吊在房间里。证据是千鹤衣服上一种只产于该山谷的蝴蝶的特殊花粉——那是他搬运尸体时，从 Arimori 肩上无意间沾过去的。
resolution.en: The culprit is Mitsuyuki Arimori. He murdered Chizuru early in the morning, first he knocked her out with a stungun and hid the corpse in the back of his van then he Strangled her with a rope when the group headed to the valley. Later, in the afternoon he used a hang-glider to get back to the hotel before the others and hung her corpse her room. The proof is a special type of pollen unique to a butterfly from the valley that was on Chizuru's clothes that had been unknowingly transferred from Arimori's shoulder when he was carrying the corpse.
